summary: Thiscall identity/path comparison on two strings. Computes the end of the path string stored at object offset 18196 of a2, then scans backward for the last backslash (92). The trailing filename v3 is compared with the string at this+65, and the string at this+1 is compared with the string at object offset 17952 of a2; the function returns true when both match. When the path has no backslash, the comparison is performed against the whole path string. Invoked by VehicleInstanceListBuilder (0x004B5C50).

local_names.this: object exposing two identity strings at +1 and +65
local_names.a2: object containing a path string at offset 18196 and an identity string at offset 17952
local_names.v3: backward-scanning pointer into the path string

operations.description: v3 = a2 + 18196 + strlen(a2 + 18196): locate the null terminator of the path string stored at object offset 18196 of a2.
Scan for a backslash only while (unsigned int)v3 > a2 + 18196, i.e. the path string at offset 18196 is non-empty; an empty path skips the scan entirely.
Walk v3 backward while *v3 != 92 (backslash) to find the last path separator; if the backward scan reaches a2 + 18196 the identity comparison is evaluated and returned directly.
After a backslash is found, advance v3 by one so it points past the separator to the trailing filename.

Return !strcmp(this + 65, v3) && !strcmp(this + 1, a2 + 17952): true when the string at this+65 equals the trailing filename v3 AND the string at this+1 equals the string at object offset 17952 of a2.
Invoked by VehicleInstanceListBuilder (0x004B5C50) to match a vehicle's identity strings against a path-derived name.
